Lakers Edge Warriors in Overtime Thriller  
LOS ANGELES (AP) — The Los Angeles Lakers outlasted the Golden State Warriors in a hard-fought overtime battle at Crypto.com Arena, winning 124-121. Down by five with two minutes left in regulation, Anthony Davis hit a clutch three-pointer to force overtime, then sealed the game with a putback dunk in the extra period. LeBron James recorded his 10th triple-double of the season with 28 points, 12 rebounds, and 11 assists, while rookie point guard D'Angelo Russell added 24 points and a key steal in the closing seconds. The victory keeps the Lakers in the Western Conference playoff race, while the Warriors’ hopes for a top seed take a hit.
llm_few_shot.label: Sports

llm_few_shot.text: Global Climate Summit Reaches Historic Agreement on Methane Emissions (Reuters) – In a landmark decision, nearly 100 nations agreed Thursday to implement binding targets to cut methane emissions by 30% by 2030, marking the most significant international climate pact since the Paris Agreement. The deal, finalized at the COP28 summit in Dubai, includes financial incentives for developing countries to adopt cleaner energy technologies and establishes a global monitoring system to track methane leaks from oil and gas operations. Environmental groups hailed the agreement as a turning point, while some fossil fuel-producing nations expressed concern over the economic impact. The accord now moves to individual ratification by national governments, with implementation expected to begin next year.
llm_few_shot.label: World

llm_few_shot.text:
Tennis: Djokovic Claims Masters Title in Thrilling Final  
MADRID (AP) – Novak Djokovic captured the Madrid Open title with a hard-fought 6-4, 3-6, 7-6(5) victory over Carlos Alcaraz in the final. The Serbian champion overcame a spirited challenge from the young Spaniard in a match that lasted two hours and 41 minutes, securing his 37th ATP Masters 1000 title and extending his dominance on clay. The win marks Djokovic’s second title in Madrid, following his 2011 triumph, and brings his career tally to 93 ATP titles.
